name: Heavy Rainfall Regime

detectionFactors.description: Strong low-level jet transporting Bay of Bengal moisture into Odisha.
+2.4 standard deviations above climatological mean.
Sustained convective towers > 14 km.

description: High convective moisture convergence producing localized extreme precipitation spikes.
recommendedModelPreference: AI Model (GraphCast/AIFS) leads short-term mesoscale pattern recognition; NWP-A provides synoptic upper-air steering bounds.

name: Monsoon Trough Regime

detectionFactors.description: Trough line passing south of normal position.
Westerly winds over Arabian Sea exceeding 35 knots.
Warm SST anomaly in Northern Bay of Bengal.

description: Established monsoon flow with widespread stratiform and convective rain bands.
recommendedModelPreference: NWP-A (ECMWF) leads synoptic trough positioning; Ensemble handles track uncertainty.

name: Severe Hailstorm Regime

detectionFactors.description: Convective Available Potential Energy exceeding 3500 J/kg.
Sub-zero isotherm lowered with strong vertical wind shear.
Polarimetric radar signals large hail core in supercell.

description: Supercell convective updrafts creating rapid frozen hail stone growth and ground impact.
recommendedModelPreference: AI Model leads micro-convective updraft detection; NWP-A provides thermodynamics.

name: Snow & Blizzard Regime

detectionFactors.description: Deep mid-latitude trough crossing Jammu, Kashmir & Himachal.
Freezing air mass with heavy 700hPa moisture advection.
High-altitude Himalayan slope uplifting freezing moisture.

description: High-altitude freezing precipitation and blizzard-force mountain winds.
recommendedModelPreference: ECMWF NWP-A high-resolution microphysics leads snow accumulation accuracy.

name: Sandstorm & Dust Storm Regime

detectionFactors.description: Cold pool gust front sweeping dry desert topsoil.
MODIS/INSAT dust index exceeding 3.8 standard deviations.
Severe atmospheric dust loading causing zero-visibility conditions.

description: High-speed dry boundary layer winds lifting particulate dust/sand over arid plains.
recommendedModelPreference: GFS NWP-B boundary layer wind shear + AI satellite dust aerosol tracking.

name: Severe Heat Wave Regime

detectionFactors.description: Persistent anti-cyclonic dome blocking cloud cover over Thar Desert.
+4.8°C above normal over Rajasthan & North-Western Plains.
Surface dry air heating with 5% soil moisture.

description: Atmospheric subsidence heat dome creating extreme ground temperatures.
recommendedModelPreference: ECMWF NWP-A and AI models show high correlation; AI model weight increased for 2m temperature lag.

name: High Wind & Squall Regime

detectionFactors.description: Steep localized surface pressure gradient along Gulf of Kutch.
Gust potential exceeding 65 km/h at 925 hPa.

description: Boundary layer wind shear causing coastal wind gusts and severe turbulence.
recommendedModelPreference: GFS NWP-B handles coastal surface boundary layer shear well; Ensemble provides gust envelope.

name: Normal / Climatological Regime

detectionFactors.description: CAPE values within seasonal baseline.
Quasi-geostrophic balance across Central India.

description: Standard seasonal weather patterns without extreme pressure or moisture anomalies.
recommendedModelPreference: Equal baseline weighting across NWP and AI models with high ensemble consensus.

name: Extreme / Unprecedented Anomaly

detectionFactors.description: Combined wind and rainfall pressure anomaly exceeds 99.9th percentile.
Extreme divergence between AI neural weather model and NWP physics dynamics.

description: Out-of-distribution meteorology triggering ForecastBridge Physics Override & NWP Safeguard.
recommendedModelPreference: AUTOMATIC OVERRIDE ACTIVE: AI model weight reduced to 10%, NWP Physics Baseline boosted to 48%, Physics Constraints strictly enforced.
